milestones.title: Walking skeleton (webhook → reading → template reply, dry-run)

tasks.title: Scaffold `services/whatsapp-globos` package (tsconfig, test runner, lint, env schema, README)

complexity.justification: Standard Node package scaffold with a known layout; no design choices beyond the env schema.

tasks.title: Webhook server: GET challenge, POST signature check on raw body, fast 200, idempotent queue per message id

verification.purpose: A GET with the right verify token returns the challenge and a wrong token returns 403
A POST with an invalid or missing X-Hub-Signature-256 returns 401 and enqueues nothing
The same message id delivered twice is enqueued once

tasks.objective: A webhook HTTP server verifies Meta challenges and signatures on the raw body, answers 200 quickly and enqueues each message id exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: A GET with the right verify token returns the challenge and a wrong token returns 403
A POST with an invalid or missing X-Hub-Signature-256 returns 401 and enqueues nothing
The same message id delivered twice is enqueued once
tasks.estimate_rationale: Signature and dedup code is short but security-sensitive and needs negative tests.

complexity.justification: Signature verification over raw bytes and idempotency need careful handling of body parsing order.

scope.justification: A self-contained feature: server, signature check and dedup queue with their tests.

duration.justification: Several small modules and negative tests, about an hour with local verification.
evidence: assumption:similar HMAC code exists in ai-api

risk.justification: It is the public entry point; a wrong signature check lets forged messages spend vision budget.

coupling.justification: Hands accepted messages to the pipeline through a queue contract shared with T6.

confidence.justification: The Meta webhook rules are known but not yet exercised in this repo, so only partial evidence.

Logs and errors never contain image bytes or the access token

tasks.objective: A Meta media client turns a media id into a validated in-memory image or a typed rejection, without ever logging image bytes.

complexity.justification: Two-step Meta fetch with authentication and format checks, all well specified.

scope.justification: One client and one validator with fixtures; no cross-cutting behaviour.

duration.justification: Client plus validator and fixture tests fit within a single focused run.

risk.justification: Handles untrusted bytes and a token, but failures are contained and covered by negative tests.

coupling.justification: Independent of the other M1 modules; only the pipeline consumes it later.

confidence.justification: The repo already has magic-byte format detection to mirror.

complexity.justification: Day boundaries, atomic counters and hashing need careful but standard design.

scope.justification: A self-contained policy and store feature with its own tests.

duration.justification: Schema, atomic increments and restart tests take about an hour and a quarter.
evidence: assumption:SQLite via the built-in node driver is enough

risk.justification: It is the spend and abuse control; a bug lets unbounded Gemini calls through.

coupling.justification: The pipeline and the conversation state both use this store contract.

confidence.justification: Requirements are exact but the store technology is new to this package.
